Default Title - Sold Out Quantity Sold Out   The Caline CP-99 "Medusa" Overdrive is inspired by the original Centaur and is a higher gain, more compact version of our CP-43 "Pegasus" overdrive. This golden beauty uses the Volume, Tone and Gain controls to exude warm, analog overdrive and boost tones with ease. With a bit higher gain on tap that the Pegasus, it lets you get into dirtier, distortion-ish territory as well. Don’t forget about the True Bypass circuitry as well. The CP-99 "Medusa" is very versatile and can create a full range of natural sounding overdrive tones. It has a very clean transparent tone when the gain is set low yet still retains a smooth sound when cranked up higher.
